notes: Time window by the AI and safety model track (model/window.py). Typical sol, not a forecast. Rule (Maryam's time_window.py): an hour is good when the sun is >= 15 deg and dust opacity is <= 1; good hours here: LTST 8-17. EVA window = the 4 h block with the highest average sun inside the good hours (average sun 42.8 deg). Sun: NASA GISS Mars24 algorithm (Allison & McEwen 2000) for Jezero 18.45 N 77.41 E on Perseverance sol 500 (2022-07-17, Ls 267.7 deg). Dust opacity 0.5-0.5, temperature and pressure: science/conditions.csv (MEDA). Temperature is NOT part of the rule: air is -44 to -31.2 C during the window. Light time from low-precision orbits (about +/-1 min).
